ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'So you will see, and they will realize' mean in Surah Al-Qalam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a promise of ultimate vindication for the Prophet and the faithful, where the 'seeing' refers to witnessing the fulfillment of divine promise and the humiliation of the arrogant. It underscores the concept of *Tajalli* (manifestation) of truth on the Day of Judgment, where hidden realities become apparent to all parties involved. This dual vision serves as a warning to the disbelievers that their current blindness will be replaced by a painful clarity.
